fixture.description: Deterministic procedural Chinese fiction: varied cast, locations, events and similar clue aliases; planted exact identifiers test retrieval and provenance, not literary realism or semantic-model quality.
fixture.characterCounts: totalChars counts generated prose; storedHtmlChars counts canonical persisted Writer HTML; indexedChars sums the exact visible chapter texts

provider: Local synthetic vectors and reranking; no external service or quality benchmark

tests.name: 01 Load a 1.56M-character, 600-chapter novel from committed IndexedDB chunks
02 Perform 24 consecutive cross-volume queries with exact source and revision checks
03 Exclude later identities across 12 disclosure boundaries and immediately clear evidence
04 Cold and warm hybrid searches process hundreds of passages without sending future chapters
05 Regain focus with unchanged source, clear evidence immediately and retain every validated vector
06 Commit an early chapter edit in Writer and re-embed only that chapter while excluding its old revision
07 Cancel an in-flight large retrieval and prevent a late response from publishing or seeding cache
08 Reload the chunked novel and verify persisted revision with providers disabled
09 Check UI heartbeat, end-to-end latency, uncaught errors and durable source integrity

queryLatency.scope: UI click through committed source read, Worker synchronization (reuse or rebuild), retrieval and rendered results; includes synthetic cold/warm provider cases
